instruction: Change the font of all italicized text to Arial while preserving the italic formatting

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font family of all italic text to Arial. Document has 21 italic runs currently in Times New Roman. Evaluator checks all italic runs have font.name='Arial'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all italic runs in the document for Arial font
Complete coverage: iterates through all paragraphs and runs, checking every italic text segment
Correct logic: checks 'run.italic' then verifies 'run.font.name == target_font'
Proper postconfig: includes Ctrl+S to save document before fetching from VM
Correct parameter handling: accesses 'expected.get("target_font")' directly (correct for type='rule')
Appropriate edge case handling: handles missing file and document opening errors
Binary scoring (1.0 vs 0.0) is appropriate for this all-or-nothing requirement
Implicit verification of italic preservation: only checks runs where italic=True, so lost italics would not be verified
